Example 9: Hypothesis Testing Means Using STATBELT Utility
Now let’s redo example 8 using the t-test that is built into STATBELT. According to the most recent report
from the Student Watch (funded by the National Association of College Stores Foundation) the average cost
for course materials (textbooks, electronic subscriptions, etc.) was $456 per course during the 2020-2021
academic year. An independent researcher decided to see if the costs have declined going into the 2022-2023
academic year. They obtain a sample of 48 randomly selected students with a sample mean course materials
cost of $339 and standard deviation $207. Test the researcher’s claim at the 0.01 significance level. Have
the costs for course materials decreased?
